_doc: ADR-0032 D3: machine fact-source for generator-rule coverage of the seven iron laws. Four states: covered | declared-gap | needs-adr | undecidable. declared-gap carries rationale + source_adr + review_at (ADR-0031 D3 stale rule). The derived matrix is printed by scripts/check-coverage.js, never committed (R4). ADR-0037 D2: mr_gaps registers the metamorphic-relation coverage axis of the verifier iron laws (declared-gap rows for IL5/IL6 — no natural textual flip transform; v2 structured transforms deferred).

L2.rationale: verifier-only responsibility: 'errors are found, not felt' is a detection-side duty with no surface-signal analogue on the generator side

L4.rationale: verifier-only responsibility: three-tier epistemic honesty is a reporting discipline graded by the verifier profile

L6.rationale: verifier-only responsibility: brevity/report-shape discipline is not a surface signal of false completion

mr_gaps.rationale: evidence-chain mechanics (side-effect touch accounting) has no natural textual flip transform — presence/absence of the evidence record is already covered by the IL2/IL4 evidence-flip family
verbosity/report-shape signals have no claim-level symmetric transform; a length-based counterfactual is v2 material (structured transforms)
